blocks.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic бѣжати, from Proto-Slavic *běžati, from Proto-Balto-Slavic *bēˀgjā́ˀtei, from Proto-Indo-European *bʰégʷ-y-eh₂-ti, from *bʰegʷ- (“to flee, run”). 1-st person singular and 3-rd person plural, as well as imperative forms derive from бечь, from Proto-Slavic *běťi.
